Name: SVE Victor - Furry Fox Sprites (match Badaro1's Anthro Victor Portraits)
Author: KBKuriations
Description:
Badaro1 recently released a very cute [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30841]Anthro Victor Portrait[/url] mod, but didn't have accompanying sprites. So, I made some. Like that mod, these are replacers; drop them in your Furry SVE mod folders where they belong (they'll overwrite crow Victor; you can get him back by reinstalling the original mod, or switch to classic feline Victor at any time through the configs).

Most of the body was recolored from classic feline Victor, but the tail is my art; I'm quite proud of the little wags and twitches in his animations. :3
